As INOVENSO, manufacturing of nanofiber production equipments is the beginning of our business activities. In particular, lack of standard devices stands out via academic studies on electrospinning method in our country and all around the world. From this point, our company beginning with producing single needle and multi-needle electrospinning devices reached in many university laboratories in very short time. Laboratory Scale Electrospinning Devices is demanded worldwide and  limited enterprises in the world that meet these needs raises serious export potential. Our company has aimed to transform this potential opportunity with serving worldwide and increasing export volume since it is founded.

Under structure of our company, Systems, layouts, mechanisms etc. solutions required for laboratories of universities are presented by designing special products with the experience gained in the production of Industrial and Laboratory Scale Electrospinning Systems. Enhancing functionality and quality methods have been improved for manufacturing everyday with innovative solutions.

Name: Optics11 Life
Description:
Mechanics matter the moment cells touch the well-plate. Optics11 Life equips life-science teams with fiber-optic instruments for real-time, non-destructive mechanical characterization of soft and living biomaterials; cells, hydrogels, spheroids, organoids, and tissues. These insights accelerate disease modeling, therapy development, and regenerative medicine.

Founded in 2011, we transformed a unique fiber-optic technology into lab-ready tools that quantify the mechanics of extremely soft, living samples, without disrupting biology. Our systems fit seamlessly into advanced labs, with easy operation, workflow integration, optical readouts, and control of physiological parameters.

What we offer:

PIUMA – Benchtop characterization of large tissues.

CHIARO – Microscope-compatible system for small tissue samples.

PAVONE – Screening-scale platform with automated indentation mapping, bright-field & fluorescence imaging, and environmental control.

CUORE – Automated contractility assays to grow and monitor musculoskeletal tissues.

Unlock the power of mechanobiology with us. Connect to learn how our solutions can advance your research.

Name: Axoft
Description: Developing a seamless bioelectronic interface.

Name: Graphene Laboratories, Inc
Description:
Graphene Laboratories Inc. located in Ronkonkoma, NY is a subsidiary of G6 Materials (TSXV: GGG $GGG.V $GPHBF ). The Company manufactures a variety of graphene-related products including Graphene Oxide and Chemical Vapor Deposition #Graphene. 
The Company also operates Graphene Supermarket, which has sold products to over 20,000 customers and currently delivers industry solutions in the areas including but not limited to conductive adhesives, epoxies, advanced composites and large-scale graphene oxide production.

Name: abberior
Description:
abberior is a company like no other. Founded as a spin-off from Prof. Stefan W. Hell’s laboratory, we have become a world-leading innovator and manufacturer of cutting-edge superresolution and confocal microscopes. We are growing and will continue to grow but we will always maintain the pioneering spirit of Prof. Hell’s lab. We do things differently. We do things better.

As the only manufacturer of superresolution microscopes, abberior develops and sells proprietary fluorescent dyes and labels ideally suited for superresolution microscopies, such as STED, MINFLUX, GSD, PALM, STORM, GSDIM, SIM, and RESOLFT. They also give outstanding results in confocal and epifluorescence microscopy as well as in single-molecule applications. Our mission is to become the leading supplier of fluorescent labels in superresolution microscopy.

Name: Elmarco
Description:
Elmarco is the world’s leading supplier of industrial electrospinning equipment for producing nanofibrous layers.

With our patented NanospiderTM technology, we transform laboratory innovations into scalable industrial manufacturing, enabling customers to integrate nanofibers into products across:

▻ Air & liquid filtration (HEPA, HVAC, water purification, oil separation)

▻ Medical applications (wound care, drug delivery systems)

▻ Energy storage (battery separators, fuel cells)

▻ Functional textiles (performance apparel, protective clothing)

Customers choose Elmarco because we provide more than equipment. We deliver complete solutions: polymer development, lab sampling, cost modelling, line customization, installation, training, and long-term service.

With 20+ years of innovation, 100+ patents, and over 250 installed production lines worldwide, Elmarco is the trusted partner for turning nanofiber research into industrial reality.

▻ Let’s create your competitive advantage — Think BIG, Go NANO.

Name: OPTOMAN
Description:
OPTOMAN is a manufacturer of custom high power, IBS-coated laser optics for photonic superheroes. 

Laser power keeps increasing and calls for innovative solutions. To meet that demand, OPTOMAN is opening a new office in Folsom, California. Huyen Vu has been appointed CEO and President of OPTOMAN Inc. This expansion is the next step in our growth. Our U.S. customers can now expect faster support while enjoying the same trusted IBS-coated, high-power optics used worldwide.

Complete dedication to quality, professional and reliable services, extensive characterization of optics, these things help OPTOMAN to follow his mission. 

“Serve the People and push the efficiency of lasers and laser systems to the next level.

- OPTOMAN does it right
The best possible accuracy and repeatability. 

- Ion-Beam Sputtering
OPTOMAN manufactures custom optical coatings exclusively with advanced IBS technology. It is perfect solution for small to medium scale prototyping and manufacturing. 

- Partnership
OPTOMAN educates its customers and helps in finding the best possible solution. 

Product portfolio consists of: 
- Ultra high reflectivity dielectric mirrors.
- Mirrors for ultrafast laser systems.
- High damage threshold thin film polarizers.
- High contrast wavelength separators, beam splitters and filters.

Name: P2i
Description:
P2i is the global leader in liquid repellent nano coating technology. 

We are a technology solutions provider focused on increasing the reliability of electronic devices by protecting them from liquid damage. Our revolutionary plasma process dramatically reduces the surface energy of a material, so when liquids come into contact with it, they form beads and simply roll off. This enables our customers to dramatically improve the performance of their products by protecting them from the effects of water and all other liquids, without affecting the look or feel of the device. 

P2i was established in 2004 to commercialize technologies developed by the UK Government’s Defence Science & Technology Laboratory (DSTL). Research and development have identified innovative applications, equipment and processing methods, culminating in a growing patent portfolio extending to over 64 families. Ongoing acquisitions have provided valuable new technologies such as antimicrobial, super hydrophilic and protein resistance coatings - making P2i the global leader in invisible surface functionality. 

In addition to headquarters in the United Kingdom, P2i has a technology centre in the United States, and an applications centre in China. P2i' provides a range of liquid protection solutions, protecting from splashes and spills right through to accidental submersion. P2i work directly with manufacturers, tailoring our patented nano coating to our customers’ needs.  With commercial expertise and proven success in mass production, not just in electionics but across 4 other market sectors, P2i delivers outstanding performance improvement to a wide range of products. 

Our coating allows users to live life more freely, safe in the knowledge their electrical devices are safeguarded against liquid damage. 


Contact P2i: marketing@p2i.com

Name: Oxford Instruments Raman
Description:
Oxford Instruments Raman (formerly known as WITec) pioneered Raman imaging microscopy and the integration of Raman with AFM, SEM (RISE Microscopy), SNOM, fluorescence microscopy, automated particle analysis, and optical profilometry. All of our instruments are modular and upgradable. 

Areas of application include: Materials Science; Pharmaceutical Research and Cosmetics; Life Sciences; Battery Research and Energy Storage; Semiconductors and Photovoltaics; Polymers; Food Technology and Nutritional Science; Geoscience; Forensics; Arts, Archaeology and Cultural Heritage Research; and Coatings and Thin Films Research.

Name: EDAX
Description:
EDAX is the global leader in energy dispersive x-ray spectroscopy (EDS), electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD), wavelength dispersive x-ray spectrometry (WDS), and x-ray fluorescence (XRF) systems. EDAX manufactures, markets, and services high-quality products and systems for leading companies in semiconductors, metals, and geological, biological, material and ceramics markets.

EDAX products include standalone tools for EDS, EBSD, and WDS, integrated tools for EDS/EBSD, EDS/WDS, and EDS/EBSD/WDS, and a free-standing micro-XRF bench-top elemental analyzer providing small and micro-spot x-ray analysis and mapping.

EDAX develops the best solutions for micro- and nano-characterization, where elemental and/or structural information is required, making analysis easier and more accurate.

EDAX designs, manufactures, distributes, and services products for a wide range of industries, educational institutions, and research organizations.

Name: AerNos, Inc.
Description:
AerNos, Inc. develops application-specific nano gas sensors for detecting harmful gases in the environment and for other electronic nose applications. AerNos gas sensors can detect multiple gases simultaneously to the parts per billion. They are tiny, accurate, affordable and use low power.

Name: MIT QP&AI Group
Description:
The world of quantum mechanics holds enormous potential to address unsolved problems in communications, computation, and precision measurements. Efforts are underway across the globe to develop such technologies in various physical systems, including atoms, superconductors, and topological states of matter. The MIT Quantum Photonics Laboratory pursues experimental and theoretical research towards quantum technologies using photons and semiconductor spins, combining techniques from atomic physics, optoelectronics, and modern nanofabrication. Our research follows four directions:

Modern silicon photonics opens new possibilities for high-performance quantum information processing, such as quantum simulation and high-speed quantum cryptography.

Solid state quantum memories based on electronic and nuclear spins are leading technologies for quantum repeater networks and distributed quantum computing.

2D materials, such as graphene, provide new capabilities in communications, sensing, imaging, nonlinear optics, and quantum information devices.

Quantum sensors enable precision measurements of time, fields, and forces for applications in the physical and life sciences.
